demo.title: flash-quote.sh
demo.code:
# Option A: add the official Flash MCP server
claude mcp add definitive-flash -- npx -y @definitive-fi/flash-mcp

# Option B: call the REST API directly (quote -> sign -> submit)
# 1) resolve the token
curl "https://flash.definitive.fi/v1/search?query=weth&chain=base&limit=1" \
  -H "x-definitive-api-key: $FLASH_API_KEY"

# 2) quote a market buy of $500 into WETH on Base
curl -X POST https://flash.definitive.fi/v1/quote \
  -H "x-definitive-api-key: $FLASH_API_KEY" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"side":"buy","orderType":"market","targetAsset":"0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006","targetChain":"base","contraAsset":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","contraChain":"base","qty":"500","funderAddress":"0xYourWallet"}'

# 3) sign quote.evm.orderTypedData, then POST /order with quoteId + userSignature

setup: Get a Flash API key: https://www.definitive.fi/flash-api#contact (a shared integrator key is in the docs for testing)
Fastest integration: `claude mcp add definitive-flash -- npx -y @definitive-fi/flash-mcp`
Or call REST directly with the `x-definitive-api-key` header (no request signing)
